extension.description: Four Markdown preview modes, continuous large-document reading, offline math and fonts, and HTML, PDF, PNG and JPEG export.
setting.preview.usePmpForAllFiles: Use PMP preview for all Markdown files through VS Code's preview buttons and commands, including small files. Takes priority over the large-document setting. Disable to return to automatic routing by file size. Small preview tabs show only the filename; large ones keep the Long Preview- prefix.
setting.largePreview.enabled: Automatically use continuous preview for Markdown files with at least 256,000 characters through VS Code's preview buttons and commands. Smaller files keep the native preview. Applies when Preview: Use Pmp For All Files is disabled. Continuous preview supports scroll sync, full-document search and headings; other extensions' preview scripts are not loaded in this view.
setting.math.fallbackToCode: Keep formulas that cannot render as literal code, including their original delimiters. PDF and image exports also use code when a formula still does not fit at 80% size. Other formulas render normally and export continues. Disable to show math errors and stop export on parsing or width errors.
setting.preview.forwardSearchIndicator: Location indicator after Forward Search in PMP Preview. Rectangle highlights the target word or block; Circle shows an expanding ring at the corresponding position. Colors follow the preview theme.
setting.preview.suppressAltMenus: On Windows, prevent Alt+E and Alt+S from also opening the Edit and Selection menus in PMP previews, including small files. Both keys still follow VS Code keybindings. Their menu mnemonics are unavailable in this view while enabled.
setting.nativePreview.suppressAltMenus: On Windows, prevent Alt+E and Alt+S from also opening the Edit and Selection menus in the native Markdown preview, including Default mode. Both keys still follow VS Code keybindings. Their menu mnemonics are unavailable in this view while enabled. Independent of the PMP preview setting.
capability.untrusted: Preview themes and fonts work in Restricted Mode. Export requires a trusted workspace.
capability.virtual: Preview is supported. PDF and image export require a locally installed Edge or Chrome.
setting.theme: Preview mode for this window. Default exports follow the actual VS Code colors and Markdown preview fonts.
setting.fontSize: Preview body font size in px. Default uses the native Markdown preview setting.
setting.lineHeight: Body line height for preview and export. Default uses the native Markdown preview setting.
setting.maxWidth: Maximum preview width in px; adapts to narrow windows. Default uses the native preview layout.
setting.pdf.fontSize: PDF body font size in pt, independent of the preview and image font size.
setting.pdf.browserPath: Legacy browser path. Leave empty to find Chrome or Edge automatically. This machine-specific path is not synced.
setting.pdf.browserPath.deprecated: Use Markdown-PMP.browserPath instead. This value remains a compatibility fallback.
setting.browserPath: Chrome or Edge executable for PDF and images. Leave empty for automatic detection. This machine-specific path is not synced.
setting.math.preview.enabled: Render formulas with PMP in previews. When disabled, the native preview can use another math provider; the continuous preview shows ordinary Markdown. The preview theme still applies.
setting.math.export.enabled: Render and validate math during export. Disable to treat it as ordinary Markdown. Independent of the preview switch.
setting.math.delimiters: Enabled delimiter modes, in order. Do not combine dollars with kramdown, or gitlab with julia.
setting.math.macros: KaTeX macros, for example {"\\RR":"\\mathbb{R}"}. Saved with your VS Code settings.
setting.math.outerspace: Require spaces around single-dollar inline math. Leave off for continuous Chinese text.
setting.pdf.paper: PDF paper size. Custom uses the configured width and height.
setting.pdf.margins: Page margins in mm. Headers and footers require at least 12 mm on the corresponding side.
setting.pdf.scale: Overall PDF scale, independent of body font size.
setting.pdf.pageRanges: Pages to export, for example 1-5,8. Leave empty for all pages.
setting.pdf.header: Header content. Use an empty array to disable it.
setting.pdf.footer: Footer content. Use an empty array to disable it.
setting.image.width: Long-image layout width in CSS px.
setting.image.scale: Image resolution multiplier. Output pixel width equals layout width times this value.
setting.image.jpegQuality: JPEG quality. PNG export is lossless.
